summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K to disclose a routine new directorship for a non-executive director, Dr. Hal Barron, who was appointed an independent director and chair of the nominating and corporate governance committee of Quantinuum Inc. on 4 June 2026. There are no deal terms, prices, or strategic actions involved. This is a standard corporate governance disclosure, not a special situation. As a foreign private issuer report under UK Listing Rules, it maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure of director changes, but does not constitute a forced/abrupt board departure or any other actionable event.
